33264825.source: FIDELIO-DKD (PMID 33264825) abstract: 'a primary outcome event occurred in 504 of 2833 patients (17.8%) in the finerenone group and 600 of 2841 patients (21.1%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.82; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.73 to 0.93; P=0.001)'. SCALE CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor pooled the count-derived RR (0.84) from 504/2833 vs 600/2841, creating a mixed HR/RR pool with FIGARO's HR; the trial reports the time-to-event HR 0.82 directly, which is the correct like-for-like estimand.
33264825.verification: Reported HR 0.82 (0.73-0.93) verbatim in the abstract; count-derived RR from 504/2833 vs 600/2841 = 0.842 corroborates direction/magnitude. Using the reported HR makes the finerenone pool a consistent HR pool (FIDELIO + FIGARO) instead of mixed HR/RR (cycle 75 audit).
